## GMS1 registration for your daughter

I’ve used your phone number as the parent contact. For entries marked NEEDS-YOU, fill in the missing information on your copy and leave conditional fields blank if they don’t apply.

| Field | Entry | What to do by hand |
|---|---|---|
| B01 Title | NEEDS-YOU | Tick the title she uses. |
| B02 Surname | SURNAME_P3 | |
| B03 Date of birth | DATE_P3 | If the form requires a different date format, reformat it by hand. |
| B04 First names | GIVEN_P3 | Add any other given names if she has them. |
| B05 NHS number | NEEDS-YOU | Enter her NHS number if known. |
| B06 Previous surnames | NEEDS-YOU | Enter any previous surnames. |
| B07 Sex | Tick Female | |
| B08 Town and country of birth | PLACE_P3 | Check that the restored value includes both the town and country. Add whichever is missing. |
| B09 Home address | ADDRESS_P1 | |
| B10 Postcode | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the home postcode separately. Copy it from the restored address if it appears there. |
| B11 Telephone number | PHONE_P1 | |
| B12 Previous UK address | NEEDS-YOU | Enter her previous UK address if she had one. |
| B13 Previous doctor’s name | Leave blank | She has never been registered with a GP. |
| B14 Previous doctor’s address | Leave blank | |
| B15 First UK address where registered with a GP | Leave blank | |
| B16 Date of leaving the UK | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the date if she previously lived in the UK and then left. |
| B17 Date first came to live in the UK | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the date if she moved to the UK from abroad. |
| B18 Address before enlisting | NEEDS-YOU | Complete only if she is returning from the Armed Forces. |
| B19 Service or personnel number | NEEDS-YOU | Complete only if she is returning from the Armed Forces. |
| B20 Enlistment date | NEEDS-YOU | Complete only if she is returning from the Armed Forces. |
| B21 Child Health Surveillance | NEEDS-YOU | Tick if she is under five and you want her registered for this service. |
| B22 Dispensing medicines and appliances | NEEDS-YOU | If she needs the GP to dispense, tick any statement that applies. |
| B23 Signature | Tick Signature on behalf of patient | Sign by hand. |
| B24 Date | NEEDS-YOU | Enter the date you sign. |

Use block capitals for written entries.
